title: Kampstraße, Bochum
description:
This spacious WG offers a comfortable and well-equipped living space in Bochum .

Apartment Features:
Fully Furnished Rooms: Each room includes a bed, work table, chair, and wardrobe.
Shared Spaces:
Compact kitchen equipped with electric kettle, refrigerator, microwave, dishes, and cutlery.
Bathroom with WC, shared with 4 flatmates.
Additional Amenities: Washing machine and Wi-Fi are provided.

Location:

It is a centrally located address in Bochum with excellent access to public transport, shops, restaurants, and everyday amenities. The area is well connected and convenient for students and professionals alike, with quick connections to Bochum city center and nearby universities.
The Technical University of Dortmund (TU Dortmund) can be reached in approximately 35–45 minutes by public transport, depending on the connection.

Additional Information:

Tenants are responsible for maintaining cleanliness during their stay.
A one-time membership fee of €60 applies.
Upon move-out, tenants must pay a mandatory bed linen fee of €30 and a cleaning fee of €130.

title: Universitätsstraße, Bochum
description:
Exclusive, fully furnished 2.5-Room apartment near RUB university (2km) – ideal for visiting professors. High-quality amenities, quiet location with beautiful view, luxury kitchen, balcony.

This stylish and comfortable 2.5-room apartment offers the perfect retreat for visiting professors and professionals. With its spacious, light-filled rooms featuring an east-south view, and premium amenities, it’s an ideal home away from your home. Enjoy stunning sunrises and an expansive, unobstructed view of the green surroundings through large, private windows. Start your day with a jog in nature right outside your door.

Features
Spacious Rooms (70 sqm): Bright, modern design with ample space
Living Room (20 sqm): 50” 4K TV, hardwood floors, and ambient ceiling lighting for cozy evenings
High-Quality Kitchen (15 sqm): Fully equipped with top-brand appliances, high-gloss cabinetry, granite backsplash, elevated oven, dishwasher, washing machine, kitchen island, and an extendable dining table
Modern Bathroom (4 sqm): Compact yet stylish with premium Keuco and Hansgrohe fixtures, large window with a scenic view— while showering!
Bedroom with soft carpet (16 sqm): Beautiful daily sunrise view
Large Balcony (7 sqm): Open green views, bathed in sunlight—perfect for your morning coffee
Premium Flooring: Modern, durable, and easy to maintain
High-Speed Wi-Fi: Ideal for home office and online teaching
Shared Amenities: Elevator, laundry and bike room

Located in a quiet, green area in the University District (Bochum-Querenburg), this apartment offers high recreational value with excellent connectivity:

Ruhr University: 1 mile
Uni-Center (shopping and essentials): 1 mile
Bus Stop: 25 meters from the door
U-Bahn U35 (Subway): 1/2 mile
Highways: Quick access to A448, A43, A40
Plenty of free parking on the street
Outdoor and Leisure: Walks to Laerholzwald forest, Ümminger Lake, and cycle paths to Kemnader Lake (10 min by bike) are practically at your doorstep.

Move-in Ready: Equipped with everything needed for a seamless stay
Internet: Telekom DSL 50 Mbps Wi-Fi included
Security: Solid, secure entry door
Entire apartment renovated in 2023

Inventory:

Bedroom: Wood bed (140 cm), large wardrobe (250 cm), 2x bedding sets, pillows, duvet, TV, desk with lamp & chair, mirror, bedside lamp, Tado smart thermostat, curtains

Bathroom: Scale, hairdryer, hand & bath towels, waste bin, mirrored cabinet, storage shelf, shower seat, curtain

Kitchen: Complete with all tableware, cutlery, cookware, and kitchen appliances; soft-close drawers and cabinets, integrated lighting, Neff dishwasher (45 cm), Siemens washing machine (1400 RPM), AEG cooktop/oven/fridge-freezer/extractor fan, coffee machine, blender, microwave, and Sodastream. Built-in trash bins and additional storage included.

Dining Area: Dining table with 4 chairs (extendable up to 6)

Storage closet: Shelves, Miele vacuum cleaner, cleaning supplies, laundry basket, iron & ironing board

Hallway: Coat rack, shoe cabinet, stool, mirror, carpet, WiFi 6 router

Living Room: Sofa, Samsung 4K 50" TV, carpet, sideboard, Philips Hue ambient ceiling lights,  Tado smart thermostat, curtains

Balcony: Table, 2 chairs, flower box, satellite, shade blinds, electrical outlet


Viewings are available anytime by appointment. Please note that smoking is not permitted in the apartment. Ideal for one to two persons. I’m happy to assist you in German, English, and French.

title: Wohlfahrtstraße, Bochum
description:
The appartment is located close to the university of Bochum. 
Accessable by bus. Quiet area, Family surrounding.

Parking area included.

Eine gute Anbindung an die Autobahnen A40, A43 und A44 monthly rent includes electricity and Heating

title: Universitätsstraße, Bochum
description:
ONLY FEMALES!
Its a friendly big townhouse with one or two fully furnitured bedrooms for rent to ONLY FEMALE students. The owner (women) live in the house. An electric iron is in the house. Bedclothes are inclusive. 
Excellent location: the room is 3 km from the university. All facility are nearby (supermarket, bakery, farmacy, doctor, etc). Metro station (with direction to the university 5 min., and to the city center 5 min. also at night!)  and Bus stops are located only 2 minutes away!  If you are interested or you want to know something else please don't hesitate to get in contact!
